description: Solana SPL token mint audit from the public Solana RPC: is the mint authority revoked (no more minting), is the freeze authority revoked, supply and decimals. Metadata immutability is NOT checked (it needs a separate Metaplex lookup this tool does not do). Related tools on this server, for a different need: agent_intel_cors_security_misconfig_audit when you need CORS check for a public HTTPS endpoint: three GET requests; agent_intel_domain_authority_credibility when you need Registration facts for a domain from the public RDAP. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
